name: gui_errors_recent
description: Read recent error events captured from the Wylde Tauri desktop GUI. Returns normalized events from logs/gui_errors.jsonl, newest first, with optional filters by time, severity, source, and route. Use this to answer "what's wrong?" with the desktop app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum events to return. Default 20, capped at 200.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only events at or after this time are returned.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Filter by the GUI route/page the error occurred on.
